5.en:
Go away before I hurt you.
Have you ever heard of insect politics? Neither have I.
Insects don’t have politics. No compassion, no compromise.
I was an insect who dreamt he was a man, and loved it.
But now the dream is over and the insect is awake.
*After David Cronenberg & Charly García
